newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups ZAG estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups ZAG estimate.

text.p: Lehman Brothers raised its earnings per share (EPS) forecast for Israel's ZAG Industries Ltd, a maker of plastic products, citing a positive third- quarter earnings surprise.

Analyst Lauren Clancy said she expected ZAG to show 1996 net earnings of $0.85 a share, up from a previous estimate of $0.79. In 1997, she sees EPS reaching $1.01, up from a previous estimate of $0.96.
Lehman also raised its 12-month price target to $18-$19 from $16-$17, based on a price/earnings ratio of 17-18. ZAG closed in Nasdaq trading on Wednesday at $16-1/8.
ZAG reported third-quarter EPS of $0.22, versus Lehman's $0.19 estimate, which Clancy attributed to better-than-expected margins.

"Positive surprises (are) likely to continue," Clancy said in a report. "(Wall) Street (is) not recognising ZAG's superior growth versus comparable companies and is thus trading it at a significant 15-20 percent discount to comparables."
